title: Trophies
content:
# Trophies

# Introduction

Trophies are items dropped by defeated creatures and can stack to 20.

## Usage

All trophies have some shared uses:
• They can be attached to Item stands to serve as decorations.
• They can be used to program the Ballista.
• All trophies will give 1 Coal per trophy if used in an Obliterator.
Some trophies have special usage:
• Some are used as crafting ingredients.
• Some are used to summon Forsaken.
Each Forsaken is guaranteed to drop a special trophy when defeated that can be returned to the Sacrificial Stones to unlock a new Forsaken power.

### Meadows

• Trophy: Boar | Drop chance: 15% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: This boar head would make for a nice decoration in any house. | ID: TrophyBoar

• Trophy: Deer | Drop chance: 50% | Usage: Mead horn of Odin StagbreakerSummoning Eikthyr | Weight: 2.0 | Description: A fine specimen but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla. | ID: TrophyDeer

• Trophy: Neck | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 0.5 | Description: The beady eyes and razorsharp teeth belies the ostensibly calm nature of this small lizard. | ID: TrophyNeck

• Trophy: Eikthyr | Drop chance: 100% | Usage: Eikthyr Power | Weight: 2.0 | Description: This severed head oozes power. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones. | ID: TrophyEikthyr

### Black Forest

• Trophy: Greydwarf | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 1.0 | Description: The mossy, severed head of a Greydwarf. | ID: TrophyGreydwarf

• Trophy: Greydwarf brute | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 1.5 | Description: It took seven blows to hack this gnarled head from its body. | ID: TrophyGreydwarfBrute

• Trophy: Greydwarf Shaman | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Heart of the Forest | Weight: 1.0 | Description: It may try to come back so be sure to prune any new shoots... | ID: TrophyGreydwarfShaman

• Trophy: Rancid remains | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 0.5 | Description: A rank and rotten skull. You're not sure why you kept it... | ID: TrophySkeletonPoison

• Trophy: Skeleton | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Unfading candles Bone tower shield Dead raiser | Weight: 0.5 | Description: The expressionless grin of this skull reminds you of the inevitability of death. | ID: TrophySkeleton

• Trophy: Ghost | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Does it still whisper about unfinished business? | ID: TrophyGhost

• Trophy: Troll | Drop chance: 50% | Usage: Mossy fishing bait Trollstav | Weight: 4.0 | Description: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols. | ID: TrophyFrostTroll

• Trophy: Bear | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Bearskin rug Headdress of the Bear Bronze Pendant | Weight: 2.0 | Description: That stare is still frightening... | ID: TrophyBjorn

• Trophy: Brenna | Drop chance: 100% | Weight: 0.5 | Description: Still burning, somehow. | ID: TrophySkeletonHildir

• Trophy: The Elder | Drop chance: 100% | Usage: The Elder Power | Weight: 4.0 | Description: This severed head oozes power. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones. | ID: TrophyTheElder

### Ocean

• Trophy: Serpent[1] | Drop chance: 33% | Usage: Fins of Destiny Heavy fishing bait | Weight: 25.0[2] | Description: The scales have dulled but the eyes are still bright. | ID: TrophySerpent

### Swamp

• Trophy: Abomination | Drop chance: 50% | Usage: Sticky fishing bait | Weight: 4.0 | Description: It's been dead so long that it started living again. | ID: TrophyAbomination

• Trophy: Draugr | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 1.0 | Description: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night... | ID: TrophyDraugr

• Trophy: Draugr elite | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Iron sledge | Weight: 1.0 | Description: The dead stare of the glowing red eyes sends a shiver through your bones. | ID: TrophyDraugrElite

• Trophy: Leech | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Iron Brooch | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Although slimy, the skin is beautifully patterned in red and black. | ID: TrophyLeech

• Trophy: Surtling | Drop chance: 5% | Usage: Nimble Anklet | Weight: 1.0 | Description: Wreathed in pale flame, it still smolders like an ember. | ID: TrophySurtling

• Trophy: Wraith | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 1.0 | Description: The shed skin of a wraith, a flowing robe only visible by moonlight. | ID: TrophyWraith

• Trophy: Kvastur | Drop chance: 100% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: A witch's best friend. | ID: TrophyKvastur

• Trophy: Bonemass | Drop chance: 100% | Usage: Bonemass Power | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Bones and viscous goo, held together by some unseen force. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones. | ID: TrophyBonemass

### Mountain

• Trophy: Cultist | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Fenris hood | Weight: 3.0 | Description: The fire in its eyes has still not burned out. | ID: TrophyCultist

• Trophy: Drake | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Drake helmet Frosty fishing bait Blob bomb: Frost | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Still cold to the touch. | ID: TrophyHatchling

• Trophy: Fenring | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Cold fishing bait Wolf Sight | Weight: 1.5 | Description: Half-way between wolf and man, its face frozen in a snarl of pain. | ID: TrophyFenring

• Trophy: Stone Golem | Drop chance: 5% | Usage: Crystal Heart | Weight: 2.0 | Description: This crystalline rock formation would make for an impressive floor decoration. | ID: TrophySGolem

• Trophy: Ulv | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 1.5 | Description: A rugged tail from a not so good boy | ID: TrophyUlv

• Trophy: Wolf | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Wolf fur cape | Weight: 1.5 | Description: Frozen in death, the hair matted with blood and a silent howl lodged in its throat. | ID: TrophyWolf

• Trophy: Geirrhafa | Drop chance: 100% | Weight: 3.0 | Description: He's giving you an icy stare. | ID: TrophyCultist_Hildir

• Trophy: Moder | Drop chance: 100% | Usage: Moder Power | Weight: 2.0 | Description: The head of a dragon, majestic even in the rigor of death. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones. | ID: TrophyDragonQueen

### Plains

• Trophy: Deathsquito | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 0.5 | Description: You don't like touching this thing even when it's dead. | ID: TrophyDeathsquito

• Trophy: Fuling | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Stingy fishing bait | Weight: 1.0 | Description: Loose folds of greenish skin gathered in around a pair of dark and hateful eyes. | ID: TrophyGoblin

• Trophy: Fuling berserker | Drop chance: 5% | Usage: Evasion Mantle | Weight: 2.0 | Description: The huge grizzled head is as heavy as a boulder. | ID: TrophyGoblinBrute

• Trophy: Fuling shaman | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 0.5 | Description: Even killing it couldn't wipe the knowing smile from its crooked lips... | ID: TrophyGoblinShaman

• Trophy: Growth | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 1.0 | Description: A black and sticky mess. | ID: TrophyGrowth

• Trophy: Lox | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Misty fishing bait Bracelets of the Brave | Weight: 2.0 | Description: A giant beast's head, thatched with thick fur. | ID: TrophyLox

• Trophy: Vile | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Vilebone Visage | Weight: 2.0 | Description: That stare is still frightening... | ID: TrophyBjornUndead

• Trophy: Zil | Drop chance: 100% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: In the choice of 'ride or die', he picked the latter. | ID: TrophyGoblinBruteBrosShaman

• Trophy: Thungr | Drop chance: 100% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Not so tough now. | ID: TrophyGoblinBruteBrosBrute

• Trophy: Yagluth | Drop chance: 100% | Usage: Yagluth Power | Weight: 1.0 | Description: The crownless head of a dead king. | ID: TrophyGoblinKing

### Mistlands

• Trophy: Dvergr[3] | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: It's frankly a little troubling that you would consider hanging these on your wall... | ID: TrophyDvergr

• Trophy: Hare | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: These are said to bring luck. But not for their original owner. | ID: TrophyHare

• Trophy: Gjall | Drop chance: 30% | Usage: Pulsating Earrings | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Hopefully it won't float away. | ID: TrophyGjall

• Trophy: Seeker | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Resounding Shackle | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Less delicate as they look. The leather of the wings catches the firelight as if remembering flight. | ID: TrophySeeker

• Trophy: Seeker Soldier | Drop chance: 5% | Usage: Re-summoning The Queen | Weight: 2.0 | Description: The head of a fallen champion. | ID: TrophySeekerBrute

• Trophy: Tick | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: It's a conversation piece... | ID: TrophyTick

• Trophy: The Queen | Drop chance: 100% | Usage: The Queen's Power | Weight: 1.0 | Description: She has seen enough. | ID: TrophySeekerQueen

### Ashlands

• Trophy: Asksvin | Drop chance: 10% | Usage: Feathery wreath | Weight: 2.0 | Description: Don't let yourself be fooled by the friendly smile, for it could easily bite your arm off. | ID: TrophyAsksvin

• Trophy: Bonemaw | Drop chance: 33% | Weight: 25.0[2] | Description: A skull made up of dense bone, as dangerous as it is protective. | ID: TrophyBonemawSerpent

• Trophy: Fallen Valkyrie | Drop chance: 5% | Usage: Jörmundling | Weight: 0.5 | Description: Though she is dead, she yearns for the blood to flow. | ID: TrophyFallenValkyrie

• Trophy: Charred Marksman[4] | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 0.5 | Description: These legs could hold infinite power. | ID: TrophyCharredArcher

• Trophy: Morgen | Drop chance: 5% | Usage: Brimstone | Weight: 0.5 | Description: The waking nightmare has met its end. | ID: TrophyMorgen

• Trophy: Volture | Drop chance: 10% | Weight: 2.0 | Description: It's like a vulture, but it thrives in volcanic climates. | ID: TrophyVolture

• Trophy: Charred Warlock[4] | Drop chance: 5% | Weight: 0.5 | Description: A warm glow seems to almost emanate from within. Handle with care. | ID: TrophyCharredMage

• Trophy: Charred Warrior[4] | Drop chance: 5% | Usage: Hot fishing bait | Weight: 0.5 | Description: Fractures line this skull, as if it has taken many hits over the years. | ID: TrophyCharredMelee

• Trophy: Fader | Drop chance: 100% | Usage: Fader Power | Weight: 2.0 | ID: TrophyFader

### Light

The following trophies emit a small light:
• Surtling trophy emits a light orange light.
• Stone Golem trophy emits a cyan light.
• Brenna trophy emits an orange light.

## Quotes

Forsaken trophies have a 5% chance every minute to speak a quote.

• Trophy: Eikthyr | Quote: So you were my death? You look so small and soft… Tell Odin he may have broken this form but the wilderness will never submit to his rules...

• Trophy: The Elder | Quote: Little thing of blood and bone, I should have snapped you like a twig! Now I wither and die, let the great tree have me...

• Trophy: Bonemass | Quote: Thank you, warrior. We who lived on in this shape were denied the peace of death for too long. We go now...

• Trophy: Moder | Quote: Sheathe your pride, creature of Odin! My long reign is at an end but those who come after me are greater still...

• Trophy: Yagluth | Quote: Do you come to gloat, little thing? Do you know how many times I have been killed, broken, banished, burned and buried? You are not the first and you will not be the last.

• Trophy: The Queen | Quote: Tell Odin that my kin will bring forth another... A monarch never dies.

• Trophy: Fader | Quote: I followed a false destiny, and it gave me nothing but ruin. Forgive me, my love...
